correctness.rationale: Read the exact 48 four-simplex facets from frozen verify.py. An independently written JS combinatorial enumeration rebuilt f=(12,60,120,120,48), all six antipodal nonedges, and 40 nonfacial triangles. The specified integer cocycle has 15 positive increasingly oriented edges, evaluates zero on ALL 120 triangular facets and +1 on EACH of the 40 nonfacial triangles. Published topology identifies H1≅Z, hence unit evaluation proves each triangle is a common primitive generator, not just nonzero mod2. Exhausted ALL 2^6×6! permutations preserving the mandatory nonedge matching and found exactly 24 simplicial automorphisms, and carrier orbits 4,12,24 with representatives (1,5,9),(1,3,8),(1,4,8); each vertex occurs ten times. Exhaustion is complete because any automorphism must preserve missing edges.
